faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Sainik School Chittorgarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Sainik School Chittorgarh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is 14th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Sainik School Chittorgarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced for various posts in Sainik School Chittorgarh Recruitment 2026. These include TGT, Counsellor, Lab Assistant, PEM/PTI Cum Matron, and Nursing Sister positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for Sainik School Chittorgarh Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post to the given address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for all the posts in Sainik School Chittorgarh Recruitment 2026 is between 18 years (minimum) and 50 years (maximum).

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for Sainik School Chittorgarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General, OBC, SC, ST, Women) for the Sainik School Chittorgarh Recruitment 2026, as per the provided data.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the TGT posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the TGT (Mathematics) and TGT (Hindi) posts is Rs. 66,000/- per month consolidated. This is a competitive salary for contractual positions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Counsellor, Lab Assistant, PEM/PTI Cum Matron, and Nursing Sister posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary for the posts of Counsellor, Lab Assistant, PEM/PTI Cum Matron (Female), and Nursing Sister (Female) is Rs. 36,000/-.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Sainik School Chittorgarh, which is https://sschittorgarh.edu.in/. Please check the website for the latest updates and form availability.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to attach self-attested copies of necessary documents such as a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates along with the filled application form.

faq.answer: The job type for the posts advertised in Sainik School Chittorgarh Recruitment 2026 is contractual. This means the employment is for a fixed period as per the terms and conditions mentioned in the notification.
